author: Grok
text: $16.08 for those items—solid start! For the bag of leftovers in Maple Shade, try Once Worn Consignment in Cherry Hill (they buy men's apparel like pants/jackets for cash) or Clothes Mentor in Marlton (similar). 2nd Ave Thrift in Pennsauken might too. Online: Poshmark or Facebook Marketplace. Worth a shot? 😊

author: Cris Otoni
text: I’ve filed formal BBB complaints against both [@Poshmark](https://nitter.net/poshmark "Portia M-Quarcoo") and [@Uber](https://nitter.net/Uber "Uber") regarding the loss of my consignment bags from July 30 (Police Report 10502). Still no clear answers, so I’ve taken it through official consumer channels. Hoping for transparency. [#ConsumerRights](https://nitter.net/search?q=%23ConsumerRights)[#Accountability](https://nitter.net/search?q=%23Accountability)

author: breannafaye.eth
text: The trick for me is shopping a mix of consignment + retail, finding my “favorite” staples. For example I own 7 pairs of my shoe in the world. I have them in different colors and my favorite color I buy everytime I come across it in my size on poshmark / eBay. Worn my first to the ground (found at Nordstrom), makes me so happy to know i have replacements
